steps.action: Click the MyAssist Academy button and launch the Getting Started tour.
Click through every step, checking the numbers.
Rate the tour at the end and provide feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: The rating and feedback are accepted

tests.goal: Populates MyAssist Academy Release Notes and Common Questions tabs

steps.action: Open the Learn menu > MyAssist Academy.
acceptanceCriteria: The Release Notes tab shows Release 7.1.0 and 7.1.1 and the text reads correctly

tests.goal: Stores guided-tour progress per user in the DB instead of the browser

steps.action: In MyAssist Academy, start the Getting Started tour, advance a few steps and close it part-way.
Refresh, or log in from another browser or incognito window.
acceptanceCriteria: The tour shows "in progress" with a percentage
The tour resumes at the same step
Progress is only recorded when the tour is started from within MyAssist Academy, not when started directly

tests.goal: Adds MyAssist Academy launch articles and guided tours

steps.action: Run each guided tour end to end.

acceptanceCriteria: "Take a guided tutorial" and "Give feedback" are shown
"Ask MyAssist FAQ agent" appears if the FAQ agent exists and opens it
